## Checklist

- [ ] Exactly one commit, squashed
- [ ] `npm run validate` green
- [ ] One app per PR; schema/validator changes are their own PR
- [ ] English only — everything here ships into users' projects
- [ ] Screenshots show the actual scaffolded app (2560×1600 PNG, no mockups)
- [ ] Every playbook step ends with a `Verify:` line
- [ ] New `npmDependencies` justified in this description, or none added

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for what each of these means.
